connector.name: Cairn by cybort360
connector.registryDescription: Log Claude Code work sessions, file edits, and tasks to your Cairn account.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package cairn-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the cybort360 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: CAIRN_TOKEN
env.description: Your Cairn API token, copied from the web app account menu. If unset, the server reads it from ~/.cairn_token.

env.name: CAIRN_API_URL
env.description: Base URL of the Cairn API. Defaults to production.
